title.narrative: 3.2.1 Number of advocacy initiatives carried out by CSOs for, by or with their constituencies at sub-national level

description.narrative: # of advocacy initiatives carried by CSOs for, by or with their constituencies at sub-national level

comment.narrative: Bandhu's and Oboyobs constituencies are gender-diverse populations. BRAC works with marginalised and vulnerable populations by generating evidence-based information for policies.

2021: This includes bilateral meeting with DGFP on approval letter for monitoring.2022: This includes youth-led advocacy with district level stakeholders on implementation of CSE and hospital management meeting on youth-friendly SRHR services.2023 (first half): This includes activation of the hospital management committee and activation of union standing committee on education, health and family planning.

2023 (second half): 3 total. Functioning Adolescent Friendly Health Corner in Savar Upazila Health Complex, Activation of Hospital Management Committee, etc.2024: 6 total. This includes for example the activation of the Standing Committee on Education, Health and Family Planning in several districts, as well as hospital management committee meeting.2025: 7 total. This includes for example, Youth Advocacy Forum on SRHR, various activation of hospital committees such as union education, health & family planning standing committee.
This target was updated as part of the 2025 annual planning process.

title.narrative: 3.2.1 Number of advocacy initiatives carried out by CSOs for, by or with their constituencies at national, regional or international level

description.narrative: # of advocacy initiatives carried out by CSOs for, by or with their constituencies at all other levels

comment.narrative: Coalition partners have previously been engaged in high-level policy consultations and dialogues such as national budget discussions.

2021: This includes roundtable discussion with NGOAB on employment quto for gender diverse young people, and bilateral meetings with NHRC on Transgender Bill.2022: This includes roundtables at national level on importance of CSE, barriers to CSE and challenges of transgender youth2023 (first half): This includes follow-up for the government's commitment and participation in regional and international advocacy spaces (CSW, CPD, UPR, CEDAW, APFSD, ICPD)

2023 (second half): 8 total. This includes policy dialogues with Ministries, influencing political parties on their election commitments, and engaging the National Human Rights Commission.2024: 16 total. This includes MoU signing with DSHE, APFSD 2024, as well as the UN Civil Society Conference and other international initiatives (CPD, CSW, etc.)2025: 7 total. This includes Advocacy meeting with DGFP and DGHS to strengthen the referral mechanism at school and local health facility, Learning and Sharing Meeting with the Policy makers, Relevant Stakeholders and School Management Committee on the experience from School-Based Psychosocial Support, Consultation Meeting with Civil Society Organizations, Expertise and Youth for Parallel Report for Bangladesh VNR, Pre-HLPF 2025.
This target was updated as part of the 2025 annual planning process.
